current_activity: XVIII SS Corps breaks out east through Bad Dürrheim toward the Danube on 24 April after being cut off
notes: Event date: Lexikon der Wehrmacht, XVIII.SS-Armeekorps, text: "Die Versammlung der Durchbruchsgruppen erfolgte in den Nachmittagsstunden des 24. April 1945 reibungslos"; Lexikon der Wehrmacht, XVIII.SS-Armeekorps, text: "und durchstießen dabei Bad Dürrheim". Event definition: the attack began about 1845 or 1900 on 24 April. Event support: one source family (Lexikon); CMH says the corps was sealed in the Black Forest from 21 April. Location: Bad Dürrheim, Baden-Württemberg with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: Bad Dürrheim stands for the corps breakout area; the Lexikon puts the corps headquarters at St. Trudpert on 22 April and Hammereisenbach on 23 April. Location support: the Lexikon names Marbach, Klengen and Bad Dürrheim on the line of advance and Immendingen on the Danube. Commander: SS-Obergruppenführer Georg Keppler. Opponents: First French Army.

source_locator: R568: p. 433; R265: text of the corps page
current_activity: The XVIII SS Corps ceases to exist on 27 April; its breakout fails and the Black Forest is quiet
notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 18 p. 433: "By 27 April the Black Forest was calm"; "The demise of the XVIII SS Panzer Corps left the Nineteenth Army with the remnants of two corps"; Lexikon der Wehrmacht, XVIII.SS-Armeekorps, text: "Am 27. April 1945 lösten sich die deutschen Truppenteile auf". Event definition: the dissolution of the German units on 27 April; CMH dates the calm of the Black Forest to the same day. Event support: two source families (CMH and the Lexikon). Location: Black Forest, southern part (representative point at Donaueschingen) with a precision of 25 km. Location approximate: a representative point at Donaueschingen for the southern Black Forest and the breakout area; neither source names the final place. Location support: the Lexikon puts the breakout group at Randen and Bad Dürrheim; CMH names only the southern half of the Black Forest. Commander: SS-Obergruppenführer Georg Keppler. Opponents: First French Army.
